rules.text: rotli is a warm, local-first Mac menu-bar notes app — your NOTES FOLDER is a memex (one folder: notes · chats · knowledge · files). THREE fronts: Inbox (emails) · Chat (AI chats) · Notes (the note system — Capture · the AI-organized 'brain' areas · Storage · Boards). Stack: Tauri (Rust shell in src-tauri/) + React + Vite + TypeScript, Bun runtime (one bun.lock, bunfig.toml). The conceptual model + vocabulary lives in the MEMEX now — memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/model.md — defer to it (rotli's docs moved into the memex; the repo keeps only the README).

The user's notes are PLAIN MARKDOWN files they own, in their notes folder — a memex by default (the plain-start default is ~/Documents/rotli); folders on disk = folders in the sidebar. The app's own state lives in a sibling `.rotli/` (settings · view state · index) — deletable with no data loss. The files are the source of truth; never lock notes into a proprietary store.

Low-pulse by design: no dock icon, no ⌘Tab entry, no badges/pings; summon with ⌥Space, dismiss and it's gone. Formatting/typography (Aa) is a RENDER layer — never written into the user's markdown files.

Stack discipline: Bun (one lockfile), TypeScript strict, React + Vite frontend, Tauri (Rust) shell. Dev: `bun run dev` (web) / `bun run tauri dev` (app). Run `bun run check` (and `bun run check:hex` for brand colors) before calling work done.

rotli READS the whole memex and WRITES only its owned surfaces per the v3.7 contract: chats/ (AI chats), inbox.md (⌥C captures), and wiki/_inbox/ NOTE STAGING (new notes land there with frontmatter id/owner/created/updated/shelf/reach + blank AI metadata; a later local-LLM files them to wiki/<area>/ — the 'brain', via the v3.7 AI Filer lane). It NEVER writes history/ (Breve's), identity/ or personality/ (the former self/), MAP, or the curated rest of wiki/ — refused at both the TS canWrite gate and the Rust is_writable guard. Contract band [3.4, 3.7] (code truth: CONTRACT_VERSION 3.7, MIN_CONTRACT 3.4 in both src-tauri/src/memex.rs and src/memex/contract.ts; v3.7 adds the additive-only AI Filer lane). VOCAB (see memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/model.md): your NOTES FOLDER is a memex (one corpus.json; one memex by default — 'corpus' is internal, never user-facing). The 'BRAIN' = the AI-organized wiki areas INSIDE Notes (filed by metadata), NOT a connected memex. A SECOND memex is a 'linked library' (advanced; the active one is writable per its perms). Storage = the memex storage/ (binaries via storage: links; a dropped file routes there). Access is metadata (note reach/owner + a per-note 'locked' flag the AI filer must respect + a per-note 'secure' flag — secrets auto-detected by a regex pass, never sent to a REMOTE model, gitignored — + the local/open/secure mode). Mirror-not-import the boundary, exactly like Breve. See memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/model.md + ~/memex-vault/STRUCTURE.md (v3.6) + memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/memex-integration.

'Everything has a chat' — any object can carry a chat (chats/<slug>.md, attachedTo: [[note]]). The Convex + CRDT multi-device sync is a DESIGN (memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/sync-design), NOT yet wired — today's build is local-first, single-device (Stage 1, Phases 0–1c).

rotli's DOCS live in the MEMEX now (memex-vault wiki/projects/rotli/, + wiki/projects/memex/ for the memex project), NOT the repo — the repo keeps only the README (plus docs/media assets the README uses + docs/archive historical). To keep new project docs going to the memex, paste the Settings → Plugins 'Use rotli for your docs' command into Claude Code. The brand kit is IN-REPO — the app-embedded canonical kit at src/brand/ (single source of truth for colors/tokens/logo/fonts), enforced by `bun run check:hex` (no raw hex anywhere outside src/brand/). Brand provenance/history lives under brand/engine-history/. Change code that a doc describes → update that doc in the memex (+ a CHANGELOG entry for user-facing changes); the README + CHANGELOG stay in the repo.

decisions.decision: Notes are plain markdown files the user owns in ~/Documents/rotli/; the app keeps only derived state in a sibling .rotli/ (deletable without data loss).
decisions.rationale: Local-first, no lock-in: files openable in any editor, backable-up, forever. The app is 'a warm window onto them,' not their owner.

decisions.decision: The Brain organizer's trust ladder DEFAULTS to Organize (was Suggest) — flipped in v0.24.1 across the UI default, the settings parse, and the Rust daemon fallback. An explicit settings choice always wins.
decisions.rationale: Seth, after living with the shipped daemon: it only ever changes a note's LOCATION + METADATA (area/tags/summary) — journaled in Activity and undoable — never the words inside a note, so full auto-organize is the intended out-of-box behavior. Locked notes (metadata-panel lock = hands off entirely), secure notes, and Main stay untouchable at every rung. Design doc §4.3 amended, dated.

decisions.decision: 2026-07-06 full cleanup: rotli's brand + docs now live IN-REPO — src/brand/ is the canonical app-embedded brand kit (enforced by `bun run check:hex`), brand/engine-history/ holds brand provenance/history, and docs/ holds the docs; smLab no longer hosts rotli.
decisions.rationale: One home for code, brand, and docs kills cross-repo drift and makes the brand kit the app's single source of truth.
